The '''Lota system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was named after the [[Lota]] [[akia]] of [[Aramandi]] society.
